scope: 继续原六项任务，按用户最新确认修改：封闭场地无人员监控、无ROI、三层柜、沿用两包腕部标定、不设自定义末端XYZ范围、随机摆放不设家具库存；main直接启动，实际夹爪闭合反馈，多视角和多物品复查，同场中断恢复。二级增加平躺地面拾取；三级先开柜门后shelf、先拉抽屉后ground，实测开门/内部参数未填前默认关闭，另四项任务不处理。

preserved: detection_points的map点位/ID/启用项/家具分组
模型类别、语音、调度和网络参数

地面原默认锚点更新0.633305、抓取Z更新-0.20；源观察后等待3秒
删除只供已移除测试入口使用的test_label

direct_kinova_reuse.initialization_changes: 等待驱动两类初始反馈分别有日志和超时；main关闭构造器自动动作，新场次由startup先张爪再收臂；resume保留实际反馈核对。
direct_kinova_reuse.import_changes: 驱动只保留ROS/action和标准库；删除不供main使用的旧相机、语音、业务抓取与标定副本。
direct_kinova_reuse.driver_contract: move 调用原 arm_run(mdeg)，fingers 调用原 finger_run(percent)；不重写目标消息与单位转换
direct_kinova_reuse.v13_adaptation: Server/arm/finger waits read configuration; unit conversion and geometric formulas retained

adaptations: 地面沿用新catch_ty的观察、横移、前伸、下降、75%/100%闭爪、直接home顺序
相机统一使用camera/wrist.py，不调用原函数内部另开的RealSense
类别使用现有赛事21类模型，保留excluded_labels等现有允许项
R/T及camera X/Z/Y输入轴顺序保留；本包默认锚点及抓取Z改为新源值
通过原KinovaRobot.arm_run/finger_run发送动作；闭合程度反馈仍决定持物状态
回位使用用户配置home_pose，得分区仍调用arm/put.py
抽屉单独配置内部几何，保留已有分段退出，三级模板保持未启用

shelf_adaptation.source_execution: 实际只有开爪和中间点运动；其他抓取/回程被注释，原True不代表持物。
shelf_adaptation.chosen_behavior: full required by competition precheck; align_only is rejected before movement
shelf_adaptation.align_formula: align=grasp；align_y=(配置detect_y+grasp_y)*2/3，沿实际执行语句，修正源注释的X中点描述。
shelf_adaptation.selection: 在当前点允许的全部类别中选离画面中心最近且有稳定深度的物品；记录/反馈/交付用实际选中类别。
shelf_adaptation.layer_order: 提示层开始向上，再向下；每观察位最多2次重拍，再看已填备用位和下一层。
shelf_adaptation.motion: open -> observe -> align -> grasp -> close/tight -> lift/retreat -> configured home -> final finger confirmation
shelf_adaptation.shared_camera: camera/wrist.py；不另开源脚本内部RealSense或第二个KinovaRobot

initialization_adaptation.initial_pose_default: 默认保留当前定位，主流程实际导航到initial_pose；仅显式--set-initial-pose发布定位

startup_reset_adaptation.source: 按hangzhou2026/jujia26的初始化顺序接入；保留现场JSON参数
new_match_sequence: 等待机械臂位姿和三指驱动反馈，分别最多initial_feedback_timeout_s秒
按actions.finger_open张爪并等待驱动动作成功
回actions.home_pose并等待驱动动作成功
准备腕部和头部相机、语音
默认保留当前定位，开始计时后导航到initial_pose
startup_reset_adaptation.resume_behavior: cancel, fresh feedback, remaining recorded retreat, stow; preserve possible load; no new match clock
startup_reset_adaptation.failure_behavior: initial device/motion failure may pause; in-match software recovery bounded; pose tolerance alone warns

speech_adaptation.changes: 保留 SummerTTSSpeaker 的已有接口、单调时钟与截止门控；匹配非锁存完成回执。完整 TTS 构建工程和模型已由 summer_tts_ws.zip 补齐，现场沿用其中已有节点。项目内 C++ 加固源码增加错误检查、正确释放和路径参数，尚未确认重新编译部署。
speech_adaptation.not_required_for_navigation: speech_2026.py 的 Vosk录音/居家人物解析、约65MB语音识别模型与历史录音；这些不是TTS合成模型

cleanup.original_kinova_trimmed: 删除闲置业务；保留动作发送、单位转换、反馈订阅与等待

numerical_checks: 直接执行catch_ty地面函数，多组相机点/角度比较横移/前伸/下降及5/75/100开合爪
桌面公式与xg_table_pick执行结果比较
柜层公式、对准点及回程与上传task2_pick_v2执行结果比较

failure_policy.failed_observation_retreat: 观察重试的home失败后允许有限复位；复位仍失败暂停，不发下一点导航
failure_policy.observation_fallback: 已配置的备用位和其他柜层
failure_policy.arm_failed_point: 等待阈值内重试；确认空爪时取消、张开、收臂后去后续点；下一轮清临时障碍重查，不记空
failure_policy.navigation_unreachable_point: 导航有限重试后只跳过本轮，下一轮清临时记录和旧代价图重新尝试
failure_policy.preclose_approach_failed: 空爪收臂后记arm_failed；本点阈值内重新观察尝试，超时复位后下轮重查
failure_policy.load_unknown_or_held: fresh unknown/unstable preserves possible load, bounded recover/stow; sustained no fresh feedback pauses
failure_policy.old_resume_migration: 保留抓放编号/计数，清除旧永久禁用/冷却/头部不完整判空标记，按配置重查
failure_policy.incomplete_observation: 有配置观察位未到达且其他位未找到物品时，仍记arm_failed，不增加空家具次数
failure_policy.delivery_priority: 3 attempts/120s; online exhaustion releases before next furniture, soft deadline keeps load for exit

failure_diagnostics: 反馈年龄及是否来自本次动作期间
位置/姿态误差；缺失、过期、错误坐标系反馈不计算
grasp_source_review.review_version: historical pre-v13 source comparisons; configured wait adaptation later recorded in main_flow_v13

record.latest_revision: 抓取源码逐项核对、观察位失败恢复与动作位姿诊断

record.initial_pose: 默认导航到目标，不默认发布目标为当前位置
record.scheduler: config_order_rounds；动态受阻下一轮重试；完整空观察两次；默认不限访问
record.speech: 本次全部稳定候选先播报，按实例统计同类数量；腕部补报，同次到点去重
record.timeout: 空爪取消/张开/收臂；已持物保留并优先交付；未知反馈暂停
record.delivery: 持物期间锁定drop，等待5秒后清图重规划，默认120秒导航窗口；耗尽保留持物暂停
record.grasp: 同一观察位发现并抓取；播报后按需原位重拍；完成整套动作后判断持物
record.ground_angle: 沿旧脚本默认0度，可用null关闭；记录fallback来源

main_flow_v13.parameters_preserved: map poses, home/place, all detect poses, hand-eye/calibration, model bytes
main_flow_v13.drop: 3 total navigation attempts / 120s inclusive window; if online exhausted, open/confirm/stow before next furniture
main_flow_v13.put: actual drop arrival then direct release; no arrival holding check; open confirmation retained
main_flow_v13.soft_exit: default 535s=600-max(30,45+20); keep possible load, complete required stow, exit
main_flow_v13.exit_failure: retry bounded 35s goals and 5s waits until real arrival or 600s TIME_UP
main_flow_v13.fingers: 6750 boundary no fatal dead zone; stable holding counts, unstable fresh feedback conservatively carried unconfirmed
main_flow_v13.pose_tolerance: fresh valid feedback after succeeded action gives warning, not independent abort
main_flow_v13.software_recovery: point errors reset/skip, scheduler rebuild, FIFO record fallback; sustained inability to cancel/stow/open still pauses
main_flow_v13.parameter_diagnostics: pre-motion full validation, source file/key/line when locatable
main_flow_v13.reposition_points: validated relation only; navigation keeps configured route order
main_flow_v13.resume_client_status: No local GoalHandle default LOST is distinguished using fresh idle server status; unknown active server goals require resolution, never cancel_all other controllers
main_flow_v13.exit_receipt: Register saved completed release once during priority exit or TIME_UP; no new motion at hard deadline
